pr.title: gh-111178: fix UBSan failures in `Modules/curses*.c`
pr.body:
- fix UBSan failures in `_cursesmodule.c`
- fix UBSan failures in `_curses_panel.c`
- suppress unused return values


<!-- gh-issue-number: gh-111178 -->
* Issue: gh-111178
<!-- /gh-issue-number -->
